purpose: Portland city music venue source-of-truth for comprehensive event collection. Venue inclusion is not a genre filter.

policy.priority: Editorial selection first: use editorialPreferenceGroups (preferred > scene > secondary) independent of ingestionStatus. The preferred group is NOT ranked internally. Maintain all official verified dated events once a source is authorized; never pad the calendar with unrelated events to meet counts.
policy.publication: Importers propose source-linked events and artwork for review; only approved GitHub PRs reach main; portfolio sync is separately reviewed.
policy.uncertainty: Do not invent missing showtimes, admission, genre, ages, images, or venue status. Hold conflicting facts. No anti-bot bypass.
policy.image: Capture source-provided event flyers/photos and attribution when available; validate event specificity, legal embedding rights and failures before displaying; do not generate graphics.

tiers.core: Existing per-venue coverage scope for active/desired calendars; editorial preference is separately recorded in editorialPreferenceGroups.
tiers.expansion: Broader coverage scope or secondary venue; preference independently specified.
tiers.watch: Not yet open or suspended; preserve user preference while excluding invented date/event listings.

editorialPreferencePolicy.preferred: User-selected favorites and previously prioritized underground venues. Research these first regardless of importer availability or venue size; the list is an unordered priority group, not a 1-to-N personal ranking.
editorialPreferencePolicy.scene: Other relevant rooms, one-off DIY spaces and independent culture; include confirmed fitting bills, but do not displace preferred venue research.
editorialPreferencePolicy.secondary: Keep existing approved events; pursue new intake only for exceptionally relevant bills or on explicit request.
editorialPreferencePolicy.access: Ingestion status is independent of preference. Blocked, absent, unopened or incomplete feeds must be reported as gaps, not penalized or counted as zero shows.
